overrides.rationale: Human-reviewed correction of the catalog epithet typo “olympiticum” to “olympicum”; GBIF returns the corrected species as the leading same-genus fuzzy match and Commons independently has exact-name files.
Human-reviewed orthographic correction from “spinorum” to the accepted same-genus species epithet “spinarum”; GBIF returns it at 95 confidence and Commons independently has exact-name files.
Human-reviewed orthographic correction from “labillardieri” to “labillardierei”; GBIF returns the corrected same-genus species at 96 confidence and Commons independently has exact-name files.

Human-reviewed nomenclatural resolution: GBIF identifies corrected “Triglochin procera” as a synonym of accepted “Cycnogeton procerum” at 96 confidence; Commons independently has exact accepted-name files.

Human-reviewed nomenclatural resolution: GBIF identifies corrected “Sarcostemma subterranea” as a synonym of accepted “Cynanchum vanlessenii” at 96 confidence; Commons independently has exact accepted-name files.
